summary: Phase 0.4 security-isolation harness correctly implements fail-closed token validation, grant enforcement, and concurrency isolation acceptance cases. All five acceptance criteria are satisfied. The verifier passes on both FAIL and PASS paths. No concrete defects found.
important_context: The S9 concurrency isolation test only checks calendar ID overlap, not identity/session/grant state isolation. This is a test-strength consideration, not a correctness defect.

The S8 broadened grant test correctly asserts that unauthorized calendars (999/998) are not disclosed, which is the key security property. The mock returns authorized calendars (101/102), which is a reasonable interpretation of the acceptance criteria.
